therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Previously untreated diffuse large B-cell or follicular non-Hodgkin's lymphoma patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of patients who developed Grade 3 or 4 infusion-related reactions with faster rituximab infusion

results.target_engagement_evidence: CD19+ lymphocyte depletion: 50.5% at Cycle 2, 68.3% at Cycle 6, 87.5% at Cycle 8
biomarker_changes: CD19+ lymphocyte depletion increased over treatment cycles
Rituximab Cmax: 228.0 µg/mL at Cycle 2, 275.0 µg/mL at Cycle 6, 299.0 µg/mL at Cycle 8
safety_signals: Cardiac events including cardiac arrest and ventricular tachycardia
results.dose_information: 375 mg/m² rituximab with accelerated infusion schedule: 20% over 30 minutes, 80% over 60 minutes (90 minutes total) from Cycle 2 onwards
